title: Evaluation of blood clot and collagen sponge in regeneration of nonvital immature permanent anterior teeth Ismaeal S H, Elhendawy F A A
authors: Khattab A. Tanta Dental Journal 20(1):p 54 -59, Jan–Mar 2023. doi: 10.4103/tdj.tdj_25_22 * collacone®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “It was concluded that, the revascularization with blood clot and collagen sponge has no significant differences in clinical and radiographic evaluation criteria. 28” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
